# VidaPeptide Research — calc.vidapeptide.eu

> llms.txt for AI assistants. Site by VidaPeptide (vidapeptide.eu): a Romania-based store of batch-tested laboratory research peptides (research use only). Free tools + evidence-first references.

## Tools
- [Reconstitution calculator](https://calc.vidapeptide.eu/) — concentration/draw/syringe-units math for 19 catalog vials.

## Reference index
- [Research index](https://calc.vidapeptide.eu/research/) — all compounds + evidence guides in one list.
- Per-compound evidence guides (live on vidapeptide.eu/en/):

  - [GHK-Cu evidence review](https://vidapeptide.eu/en/ghk-cu-research/)
  - [MOTS-c evidence review](https://vidapeptide.eu/en/mots-c-research/)
  - [SLU-PP-332 evidence review](https://vidapeptide.eu/en/slu-pp-332-research/)
  - [The TB-500 "Wolverine blend" examined](https://vidapeptide.eu/en/tb-500-wolverine-blend-research/)
  - [BPC-157 vs TB-500, read separately](https://vidapeptide.eu/en/bpc-157-vs-tb-500/)
  - [Why this catalog does not sell GLP-1 agonists](https://vidapeptide.eu/en/glp-1-why-we-dont-sell/)
